_source: X12 Claim Adjustment Reason Codes, https://x12.org/codes/claim-adjustment-reason-codes. Descriptions shortened; only codes this system uses are included.

codes.description: The procedure code is inconsistent with the modifier used, or a required modifier is missing.
Claim/service lacks information or has submission/billing error(s).
This care may be covered by another payer per coordination of benefits.
The time limit for filing has expired.
Patient cannot be identified as our insured.
Charge exceeds fee schedule/maximum allowable or contracted/legislated fee arrangement.
Non-covered: not deemed a medical necessity by the payer.
Benefit for this service is included in the payment/allowance for another service already adjudicated.
Claim/service not covered by this payer/contractor; send to the correct payer/contractor.
Benefit maximum for this time period or occurrence has been reached.
Patient/insured health identification number and name do not match.
